controls_verified: Skill-body lookup rejects traversal, absolute-path escape, and symlink escape outside an explicit STARLIGHT_SKILLS_ROOT.
Shared HTTP rejects 0.0.0.0 and remains loopback-only by default.
Catalog and certification paths reject traversal and symlink indirection.
Lifecycle transitions, schema bypass, and vacuous certification evidence fail closed.
Publication and syndication adapters refuse to claim mutations they did not perform.
Security exceptions are exact and content-addressed; stale, duplicate, malformed, or changed evidence is rejected.
